name: Grade 9 IIIT Practice: October Week 6 - Project Problem
description: Practice words for Grade 9 third-trimester STEM and cybersecurity work.

words.definition: A clear sentence explaining the problem.
words.example: The problem statement explained that students needed a safer way to remember passwords.

words.definition: A person who uses a product or system.
words.example: The user was a student who needed help choosing safer online habits.

words.definition: A limit or rule for a project.
words.example: One constraint was the limited time, materials, or school rules.

words.definition: A tool used to make or test an early version.
words.example: The prototype tool helped the group test the idea before building the final version.

words.definition: A record of project notes and tests.
words.example: The logbook recorded the date, change, test, and result.

words.definition: An item or part used for work.
words.example: Cardboard was the material used for the first model section.

words.definition: To try something and check what happens.
words.example: The team can test whether the warning label is easy to understand.
